vb_textbox.text: Click a gnome at random to see which coloured gnomes give you the most harvest at first and then stick with the same two coloured gnomes who  give you the most harvest. Yours may be different but the gnomes in my game that gave the most mushrooms were red and green. Stick with them through the game, they will give you 1 or 2 mushrooms sometimes but mostly 8 or 9 mushrooms mostly! Good luck! Happy mushroom hunting :)
